guides.title: 原理、算例與驗證：天文高解析光譜儀
guides.titleEn: Principles, examples and verification: High-resolution astronomical spectrographs
guides.concept: 以 HARPS 與 ESPRESSO 這類光纖饋入、真空溫控的階梯光柵光譜儀為對象，說明為何 1 m/s 的恆星速度只相當於偵測器上 18.7 nm 的譜線位移，再把階梯光柵與交叉色散、光展量與擾頻、環境穩定、ThAr／標準具／頻率梳校正、CCD 系統誤差與重心修正整合成可驗收的徑向速度量測鏈。
guides.conceptEn: Using fibre-fed, vacuum-stabilised echelle spectrographs such as HARPS and ESPRESSO, show why a 1 m/s stellar velocity is only an 18.7 nm line shift on the detector, then integrate echelle and cross-dispersion, étendue and scrambling, environmental stability, ThAr, etalon and comb calibration, CCD systematics and barycentric correction into an acceptable radial-velocity measurement chain.
procedure: 系外行星繞行時使恆星沿視線方向週期性前後運動，恆星吸收譜線因都卜勒效應位移 δλ/λ = v/c。地球質量行星繞類太陽恆星一年軌道只造成約 9 cm/s 的速度半振幅，木星約 12.5 m/s，因此光譜儀必須在數千條譜線上量出遠小於一個像素的位移。解析力 R = λ/Δλ 決定譜線被分開與取樣的程度：R 越高譜線側翼越陡、每條線攜帶的速度資訊越多，但每個解析元素分到的光子越少，所以 R 的選擇是解析度、通量與儀器尺寸之間的取捨。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「恆星譜線的都卜勒位移」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

階梯光柵以每毫米數十條的粗刻線在大入射角、高繞射級（m 約 60 到 160）下工作，滿足 mλ = d(sinα + sinβ)。在 Littrow 配置 α ≈ β ≈ θ_B，角色散 dβ/dλ = 2tanθ_B/λ 只取決於閃耀角，因此 R4（tanθ_B = 4）光柵的角色散比一般一級光柵高一個數量級。代價是相鄰繞射級重疊，每一級只有很窄的自由光譜範圍 FSR = λ/m，所以要用稜鏡或低刻線密度光柵在垂直方向做交叉色散，把數十個繞射級排成二維梯狀影像鋪滿大面積 CCD。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「R4 階梯光柵與交叉色散器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

對狹縫限制的光譜儀，R·φ·D_T = 2·d_col·tanθ_B：望遠鏡口徑 D_T 越大、天空孔徑 φ 越大，要維持同樣的 R 就需要越大的準直光束與光柵，這是 8 m 級望遠鏡高解析光譜儀體積龐大的根源。光纖把望遠鏡焦面與溫控光譜儀分開，並以擾頻讓輸出的近場與遠場不再跟隨輸入光點位置；八角形或方形芯光纖改善近場擾頻，雙擾頻器以透鏡交換近場與遠場。瞳切割與變形光學把光束切半或壓縮單一方向，等效縮小所需的光柵尺寸。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光纖饋入與擾頻器」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

光譜儀內任何環境變化都會直接變成譜線位移：空氣折射率 n − 1 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴ 隨壓力改變而使所有波長整體平移，溫度則改變光柵週期、光學座長度與偵測器位置。因此 HARPS 與 ESPRESSO 類儀器把光學平台放進真空容器，外加多層主動溫控屏蔽，以 mK 等級的長期穩定為目標；光學座採用低膨脹材料或同材料對稱結構，偵測器有獨立的低溫恆溫器，電子設備與真空泵等熱源移到容器之外。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「真空容器與溫控屏蔽」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

波長解把像素位置對應到真空波長，校正源決定能達到的精度。ThAr 空心陰極燈提供數千條絕對波長已知的譜線，但亮度差異大、彼此混疊，氬線隨燈壓位移且燈管會老化；Fabry–Pérot 標準具產生間距均勻、亮度一致的密集譜線，適合描繪像素尺度的色散，但絕對位置隨腔長漂移，需要用 ThAr 或原子譜線錨定。雷射頻率梳的每條梳齒 f_n = f_ceo + n·f_rep 由原子鐘參考，間距需經濾波腔放大到 15 至 30 GHz 才能被光譜儀解析，提供最高的準確度與可重現性。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「ThAr 燈、標準具與雷射頻率梳」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

在光子雜訊限制下，RV 不確定度 σ_v = c/(Q·√N_e)，N_e 是全部光譜收集到的光電子數，品質因子 Q 描述光譜中譜線的密度與陡度：低溫、慢自轉的 K 矮星 Q 高，高溫、快自轉的 A 型星 Q 很低。實際精度還要加上儀器項：校正源、光纖照明變化、偵測器、熱機構漂移與地球大氣吸收線污染，各項以均方根相加。預算表的目的是讓每個子系統負責人事先知道自己能分到多少誤差，而不是事後找解釋。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「光子雜訊與 RV 誤差預算表」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

二維梯狀影像要經過級追蹤、散射光扣除、最佳萃取與閃耀函數平場校正，才得到每一級的一維光譜，再以交叉相關遮罩或模板比對求 RV。大面積 CCD 帶進三種與速度相關的系統誤差：電荷轉移效率不足使譜線向讀出方向拖尾，且拖尾比例隨通量改變；光罩拼接造成週期性的像素尺寸誤差；像素內量子效率不均。地球公轉使恆星譜線一年內在偵測器上來回移動數十個像素，這些誤差因此被轉成週期一年的假訊號。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「大面積 CCD 與萃取管線」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

量到的速度包含地球自轉與公轉，必須修正到太陽系重心，而修正要用曝光期間光通量加權的中點時間，不是幾何中點；雲層或導星變化會讓兩者不同。曝光計在光譜儀內分出一小部分光，記錄通量隨時間的變化以求出加權時間。最後以多顆長期穩定的 RV 標準星、太陽光與校正源夜間漂移紀錄驗收整機，並把光纖組、溫控設定、校正序列與管線版本寫入交接文件。 師傅任務：以方塊圖畫出能量或訊號通過「曝光計、重心修正與 RV 標準星」的路徑，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由環境或製造決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
procedureEn: When an exoplanet orbits, its star moves periodically toward and away from us and its absorption lines shift by δλ/λ = v/c. An Earth-mass planet in a one-year orbit around a Sun-like star produces a velocity semi-amplitude of only about 9 cm/s and Jupiter about 12.5 m/s, so the spectrograph must measure shifts far smaller than a pixel across thousands of lines. Resolving power R = λ/Δλ sets how well lines are separated and sampled: higher R steepens line flanks and gives each line more velocity information, but spreads photons over more resolution elements, so choosing R trades resolution, throughput and instrument size. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Doppler shift of stellar lines”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

An echelle uses coarse rulings of tens of grooves per millimetre at steep incidence and high orders, m of about 60 to 160, obeying mλ = d(sinα + sinβ). In Littrow, α ≈ β ≈ θ_B, the angular dispersion dβ/dλ = 2tanθ_B/λ depends only on the blaze angle, so an R4 grating with tanθ_B = 4 disperses an order of magnitude more than a first-order grating. The price is overlapping orders, each with a narrow free spectral range FSR = λ/m, so a prism or low-groove-density grating cross-disperses perpendicular to the echelle and stacks dozens of orders into a two-dimensional ladder that tiles a large CCD. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “R4 echelle and cross-disperser”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

For a slit-limited spectrograph R·φ·D_T = 2·d_col·tanθ_B: a larger telescope aperture D_T or sky aperture φ demands a larger collimated beam and grating for the same R, which is why high-resolution spectrographs on 8 m telescopes are so large. Fibres separate the telescope focus from the thermally controlled spectrograph and scramble the light so the output near and far fields no longer follow the input spot position; octagonal or square cores improve near-field scrambling and a double scrambler swaps near and far fields with lenses. Pupil slicing and anamorphic optics split the beam or compress one axis, effectively shrinking the grating required. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Fibre feed and scrambler”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Any environmental change inside a spectrograph becomes a line shift: the refractive index of air, n − 1 ≈ 2.7×10⁻⁴, varies with pressure and translates all wavelengths together, while temperature changes grating period, bench length and detector position. HARPS- and ESPRESSO-class instruments therefore put the optical bench inside a vacuum vessel wrapped in nested actively controlled thermal shields aiming at mK-level long-term stability; benches use low-expansion or symmetric same-material structures, the detector has its own cryostat, and heat sources such as electronics and vacuum pumps are moved outside the vessel. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Vacuum vessel and thermal shields”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The wavelength solution maps pixel position to vacuum wavelength, and the calibration source sets the attainable precision. ThAr hollow-cathode lamps give thousands of lines with known absolute wavelengths, but their brightness varies widely, lines blend, argon lines shift with lamp pressure and lamps age; Fabry–Pérot etalons give dense, evenly spaced lines of uniform brightness that map dispersion at pixel scale, but their absolute positions drift with cavity length and must be anchored to ThAr or atomic lines. A laser frequency comb, with each tooth at f_n = f_ceo + n·f_rep referenced to an atomic clock, needs filter cavities to raise its spacing to 15 to 30 GHz so the spectrograph can resolve it, and delivers the highest accuracy and repeatability. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “ThAr lamp, etalon and laser frequency comb”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

In the photon-noise limit the RV uncertainty is σ_v = c/(Q·√N_e), where N_e is the number of photoelectrons collected over the spectrum and the quality factor Q describes line density and steepness: cool, slowly rotating K dwarfs have high Q while hot, fast-rotating A stars have very low Q. Real precision adds instrumental terms, namely calibration source, fibre-illumination changes, detector, thermo-mechanical drift and telluric-line contamination, combined root-sum-square. The budget table tells each subsystem owner in advance how much error they may consume rather than explaining failures afterwards. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Photon noise and RV budget table”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

The two-dimensional ladder becomes one-dimensional spectra per order only after order tracing, scattered-light subtraction, optimal extraction and blaze flat-field correction, and RV is then derived by cross-correlation masks or template matching. Large CCDs add three velocity-related systematics: charge-transfer inefficiency trails lines toward the readout with a flux-dependent fraction, mask stitching creates periodic pixel-size errors, and quantum efficiency varies within each pixel. Earth's orbit sweeps stellar lines tens of pixels across the detector each year, turning these errors into spurious annual signals. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Large CCD and extraction pipeline”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Measured velocities contain Earth's rotation and orbital motion and must be corrected to the solar-system barycentre using the flux-weighted midpoint of the exposure rather than its geometric midpoint, since clouds or guiding changes make the two differ. An exposure meter picks off a small fraction of the light inside the spectrograph and records flux versus time to obtain that weighted time. Final acceptance uses several long-term RV-stable standards, sunlight and nightly calibration-drift records, and the handoff document fixes the fibre link, thermal set points, calibration sequence and pipeline version. Mentor task: draw a block diagram of the energy or signal path through “Exposure meter, barycentric correction, RV standards”, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by environment or fabrication, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

pitfalls: 只看解析力規格而忽略取樣，每個解析元素少於 2 個像素時譜線欠取樣，像素內響應差異會轉成隨地球公轉速度改變的假訊號；反之若在口徑不足的望遠鏡上把 R 推得過高，每個解析元素的光子不足，RV 精度反而變差。
頻率梳濾波腔失鎖時，被抑制的鄰近梳齒重新出現，每條譜線變成不對稱的混疊，重心偏移數 m/s 卻仍看似正常譜線；更換 ThAr 燈管後若沒有重新建立參考，氬線壓力位移會讓整個波長解出現跳點。
pitfallsEn: Quoting resolving power while ignoring sampling leaves lines undersampled below 2 pixels per resolution element, so intrapixel response differences become spurious signals that vary with Earth's orbital velocity; conversely, pushing R too high on a small aperture starves each element of photons and degrades RV precision.

When a comb's filter cavity loses lock, suppressed neighbouring modes reappear and each line becomes an asymmetric blend whose centroid moves several m/s while still looking normal; replacing a ThAr lamp without re-establishing the reference lets argon pressure shifts introduce a jump into the whole wavelength solution.

related.title: 光學頻率梳穩定系統
related.transfer: 可遷移「徑向速度量測需求與解析力」與「波長校正源：ThAr、標準具與頻率梳」的建模、量測與誤差預算方法；光學頻率梳穩定系統的元件、尺度與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The modelling, measurement and error-budget methods of "Radial-velocity requirements and resolving power" and "Wavelength calibration: ThAr, etalons and frequency combs" transfer, while components, scales and acceptance conditions of Optical-frequency-comb stabilization systems must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦階梯光柵色散、光纖擾頻、真空溫控、波長校正與公分每秒級徑向速度誤差預算；光學頻率梳穩定系統則以f_n = n·f_rep + f_ceo、f-2f 自參考與雙迴路鎖相的梳狀雷射工程為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on echelle dispersion, fibre scrambling, vacuum thermal control, wavelength calibration and cm/s radial-velocity error budgets; Optical-frequency-comb stabilization systems centres on comb engineering around f_n = n·f_rep + f_ceo, f-2f self-referencing and dual-loop phase locking, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.

practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the inputs, outputs and main disturbances of “Doppler shift of stellar lines” and “Comb equation and carrier-envelope phase”.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 天文高解析光譜儀
history.text: 1995 年 Michel Mayor 與 Didier Queloz 以 ELODIE 光纖光譜儀的交叉相關技術發現 51 Pegasi b，精度約 10 m/s 等級；2003 年起 ESO 3.6 m 望遠鏡上的 HARPS 以真空溫控容器與同步 ThAr 參考把長期精度推進到約 1 m/s，2010 年代又在其上測試雷射頻率梳。2017 年 ESPRESSO 在 VLT 組合庫德實驗室取得初光，可接收單一或四座 8.2 m 單元望遠鏡的光，以 10 cm/s 為長期目標。本課只重建公開的物理與工程邏輯。
history.textEn: In 1995 Michel Mayor and Didier Queloz discovered 51 Pegasi b using cross-correlation with the fibre-fed ELODIE spectrograph at roughly 10 m/s precision; from 2003 HARPS on the ESO 3.6 m telescope pushed long-term precision to about 1 m/s with a vacuum, temperature-controlled vessel and simultaneous ThAr reference, and laser frequency combs were tested on it during the 2010s. In 2017 ESPRESSO saw first light in the VLT combined coudé laboratory, accepting light from one or all four 8.2 m Unit Telescopes with a long-term goal of 10 cm/s. This course reconstructs only public physics and engineering logic.

history.title: 從工程史到可驗證模型
history.titleEn: From engineering history to verifiable models
history.text: 本課把「徑向速度量測需求與解析力」到「重心修正、天上驗證與工程交接」改寫為 32 個原創分析、量測與診斷任務；不複製來源圖片、影片逐字稿或現場程序。
history.textEn: The course turns "Radial-velocity requirements and resolving power" through "Barycentric correction, on-sky validation and handoff" into 32 original analysis, measurement and diagnosis tasks without copying source images, video transcripts or field procedures.
